text:
alex: Heads-up — PR #15420 is passing locally but CI is flaking on macOS snapshot tests. Blocking merge for the release window. Can someone with mac approvals take a quick look? @maya @jon
maya: On it. Which test is failing?
alex: tests/ui/render_snapshot_test — screenshot diff with dynamic timestamp region. CI log snippet: ```diff --- expected.png +++ actual.png @@ -10,7 +10,7 -timestamp: 2025-11-05T12:34:56Z +timestamp: 2025-11-05T12:34:57Z``` Looks like noise.
ci-bot: Build pr-15420/567 failed on macos-snap-3: snapshot mismatch (exit code 1). Retry suggested.
sam: I can trigger a targeted rerun for that shard but need an approval from two owners to bump it through the queue. @maya you good to approve a rerun?
maya: I can approve the rerun. Quick idea: if the test uses system time, we should freeze it in the harness. I'll propose a follow-up patch if we confirm it's flaky.
jon: If the PR is purely logging cleanup, snapshot diffs are probably flaky. Recommend rerun x2 before updating snapshots.
alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/15420 — changes unrelated to render. Requesting rerun + hold merge until green. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ci-bot: Rerun triggered by @sam: build pr-15420/568 queued.
sam: kicked off, watching logs. If it fails twice, we should bisect.
maya: Ran locally with `TEST_ENV=ci make test-render` — passing for me. Leaning toward transient flake. +1 for rerun.
jon: +1 for rerun. Also heads-up: we've seen this shard noisy between 03/01-03/05, might be infra noise. Could open a follow-up with eng-sre if it recurs.
alex: Agreed. If rerun succeeds, can one of you approve the PR for merge before tomorrow's deploy window?
maya: I'll approve post-green. Ping me again after CI passes.
sam: FYI we tracked a similar flicker earlier — notes in #incidents: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/incidents/p12345
alex: Thanks — if rerun fails again I'll start a bisect and add @eng-sre to the PR.
jon: I can run a bisect if you want; shout if you need help. Also please add a small note in the PR description about investigating the flake.
alex: Done — added investigation note and screenshots. Thanks all :pray:
ci-bot: Build pr-15420/568 SUCCESS on macos-snap-3. All checks green.
maya: Approving the PR now. :white_check_mark:
jon: Approved and will merge in ~5m unless objections.
sam: No objections, thanks everyone.
alex: Merged. Closing the hold and filing a short follow-up ticket to add time-freeze in render tests. :tada:
